rules.detail: refers to its source: 'According to the passage'

review.suggested_question: What criticism was made of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana regarding public-sector banks?
review.suggested_answer: it has created unnecessary work-burden on the public-sector banks
review.evidence_quote: that it has created unnecessary work-burden on the public-sector banks
review.comment: 'According to the passage' makes it non-standalone, and 'main issue' is subjective since the passage lists several criticisms; the answer restates the question.

review.suggested_question: Within how many days after a death should a PMJJBY claim be filed, a window cited as a reason for the scheme's failure during COVID-19?
review.evidence_quote: There is a very small window of 30 days post-death (with the caveat "preferably") to apply for the claim
review.comment: The gold answer is cut off mid-sentence, and the passage gives three reasons (claim window, no policy document, no guidance manual), so 'the reason' has no single answer; narrowing the question fixes it.

review.suggested_answer: to bring the member of parliament of all the political parties under the same umbrella while taking the responsibility of developing physical and institutional infrastructure in villages and turning them into model villages
review.evidence_quote: Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana was initiated to bring the member of parliament of all the political parties under the same umbrella
review.comment: The gold answer is truncated ('infra- struc') and restates the question; use the passage span.

review.suggested_answer: all elderly above 59 years of age and widows whose annual income from all sources is below ₹24,000 (US$250)
review.evidence_quote: In Odisha, for instance, all elderly above 59 years of age and widows whose annual income from all sources is below ₹24,000 (US$250) are eligible for the Madhu Babu Pension Scheme.
review.comment: The answer is correct but repeats the question; trim it to the eligibility span.

review.suggested_question: According to the ORF study on Digital India, what was rural tele-density compared with urban areas?
review.evidence_quote: The ORF study noted that tele-density stood at about 59% against 131% in urban areas
review.comment: The answer ends in stray Chinese characters ('商业平') and is truncated; the question also wrongly suggests the ORF study implemented Digital India.

review.suggested_question: Of the amount allocated to the Smart Cities Mission, what share had been spent as of 2019?
review.suggested_answer: only 21% of the ₹166 billion (US$1.7 billion) allocated
review.evidence_quote: As of 2019, of the ₹166 billion (US$1.7 billion) allocated to the mission, only 21% had been spent.
review.comment: The passage dates the 21% spend to 2019, not 2022, and 'the mission' does not name the scheme.

review.suggested_question: Which Telangana scheme, on which PM-KISAN was modelled, received accolades from organisations including the World Bank?
review.evidence_quote: The scheme was first conceived and implemented by Government of Telangana as the Rythu Bandhu scheme
review.comment: 'the government scheme that received accolades' can't be answered without the passage; name PM-KISAN/Telangana. The answer is correct.

review.suggested_question: In MGNREGA social audits, what are the 'Janasunani' (public hearing) and the right to information (RTI) used to fight?
review.evidence_quote: As the corruption is attributed to the secrecy in governance, the 'Janasunani' or public hearing and the right to information (RTI), enacted in 2005, are used to fight this secrecy.
review.comment: The question has a stray quote mark; the answer merges two clauses. The passage says they fight secrecy; the social audit as a whole prevents corruption.

review.suggested_question: By 2017, what were PDS leakages down to in aggregate after implementation of the NFSA?
review.suggested_answer: about 15% in aggregate and about 7%-10% conditional on purchasing from the PDS
review.evidence_quote: By 2017, leakages were down to about 15% in aggregate and about 7%-10% conditional on purchasing from the PDS.
review.comment: The passage gives no percentage for MP/Odisha/WB households; it says only a 'majority' got full entitlements. The gold figures are leakage rates, so the question should ask about leakages.

review.suggested_question: Between which two organisations was a memorandum of understanding exchanged for India's first Skill India International Centre in Bhubaneswar?
review.suggested_answer: the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the Skill Development Institute (SDI)
review.evidence_quote: A memorandum of understanding was exchanged between the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and the Skill Development Institute (SDI)
review.comment: The passage does not state SDI's significance; the gold answer quotes an unrelated sentence about Cabral and Dhar (2019).

review.suggested_question: What is the name of Qualcomm's programme to mentor ten Indian hardware companies under Make in India?
review.evidence_quote: Qualcomm: "Design in India" programme to mentor ten Indian hardware companies
review.comment: The passage does not name the ten companies, and the gold answer does not list them; rewrite to ask for the programme name.

review.suggested_question: How many people does the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) benefit?
review.evidence_quote: benefiting 81.35 crore people (approximately 56.81% population) in India
review.comment: 'Scale' is vague and the answer restates the sentence; ask for the beneficiary count and use the exact span.

review.suggested_question: Under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, what percentage of the planned habitations (population above 500 in plains, above 250 in hilly areas) were connected by December 2017?
review.evidence_quote: 82% were already connected by December 2017
review.comment: The question asks 'how many' but the answer is a percentage, and it does not name PMGSY.

review.suggested_question: What loan amount does the Stand Up India Loan Scheme provide for setting up a greenfield enterprise?
review.suggested_answer: between Rs.10 lakhs and Rs.1 crore
review.evidence_quote: It is similar to but distinct from Startup India.
review.comment: The passage does not explain the difference from Startup India, and the gold answer is invented and truncated; replace the question.

review.suggested_question: For about how many houses in Uttar Pradesh were applications sought under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana in 2020?
review.evidence_quote: Applications have been sought under this scheme for about 3,516 houses in Uttar Pradesh.
review.comment: The passage says applications were sought, not that the houses were 'planned to be built'; trim the answer to the span.

review.suggested_question: What does the Swachh Bharat campaign's official Hindi name translate to in English?
review.evidence_quote: The campaign's official name is in Hindi. In English, it translates to "Clean India Mission".
review.comment: The Hindi name was lost in extraction, so the passage cannot answer the question, and the gold answer is not an answer at all. 'the campaign' also doesn't name the scheme.

review.suggested_question: What did Swaminathan Aiyar, writing in The Economic Times, say about India's drive for self-sufficiency in the 1960s and 1970s, in reaction to Atmanirbhar Bharat?
review.suggested_answer: it was unsuccessful, and doing the same thing again was not advisable
review.evidence_quote: Swaminathan Aiyar, writing for The Economic Times, said in the 1960s and 1970s, India's drive for self-sufficiency was unsuccessful, and doing the same thing again was not advisable.
review.comment: The question wrongly implies Aiyar argued in the 1960s-70s; he commented recently about that period. The answer content is otherwise right.

review.suggested_question: In which month and year was a software engineer arrested for creating an app that exploited vulnerabilities in the official Aadhaar app?
review.evidence_quote: In August 2017, a software engineer was arrested after he created an app that exploited vulnerabilities in the official Aadhaar app
review.comment: The engineer is not named; Ravi Shankar Prasad is the minister who retweeted an image. Either rewrite as shown or relabel as unanswerable near-miss if the annotator confirms no other chunk names him.

review.evidence_quote: Mukesh Ambani, a businessman with close ties to Modi, directly controls media outlets followed by at least 800 million Indians.
review.comment: The passage (tagged mudra) is about democratic backsliding and press freedom, not a government scheme, and the answer doesn't address the 'impact on television coverage' question. If it is kept, a fallback is 'How many Indians follow media outlets controlled by Mukesh Ambani?' -> 'at least 800 million'.

review.suggested_question: After the expansions in June 2003 and August 2004, how many families did the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cover?
review.evidence_quote: bringing the total number of families covered up to 20,000,000. after this additional 50 lakh families were added in 2013.
review.comment: The passage adds 50 lakh more families in 2013, so 20,000,000 is not the overall total; scope the question to the 2003/2004 expansions.

review.suggested_answer: Supplementary nutrition; Nutrition and Health Education; Immunisation; Health checkup; Referral services; Pre-school education(Non-Formal); Contraceptive counselling for adolescents
review.evidence_quote: Contraceptive counselling for adolescents
review.comment: The gold answer omits the seventh listed service and spells 'Immunization' where the passage has 'Immunisation'.

review.suggested_question: When did the Union Cabinet approve the launch of the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM)?
review.evidence_quote: the Union Cabinet, in May 2013, has approved the launch of National Urban Health Mission (NUHM) as a sub-mission of an overarching National Health Mission (NHM)
review.comment: The passage never states NUHM's goal; the gold answer describes NRHM/NHM and wrongly gives rural coverage as NUHM's goal.

review.suggested_question: What monthly earnings by any family member exclude a household from the Indira Awaas Yojana?
review.evidence_quote: Any member of the family is earning more than 15,000 rupees per month;
review.comment: 'this program' doesn't name the scheme, and the answer is truncated and covers only 4 of 13 exclusion parameters. Narrow to one criterion, or ask for the count ('13').

review.evidence_quote: Average LPG consumption of PMUY consumers has increased by 20 percent from 3.01 refills in 2019-20 to 3.68 in 2021-22.
review.comment: The answer restates the question and drops the unit (refills); give the bare figure with its unit.

review.suggested_question: Who launched Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana in September 2018?
review.evidence_quote: It was launched in September 2018 by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
review.comment: 'Who is the Prime Minister of India?' is general knowledge, time-sensitive, and not about the scheme. The passage only supports who launched PM-JAY.

review.evidence_quote: Maximum Limit: You can deposit up to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year.
review.comment: Correct content; trim to the span.

review.suggested_answer: Holistic view of education; Equity; Access; Gender concern
review.evidence_quote: The changes encompass the vision and approach to elementary education, guided by the following principles:
review.comment: The gold answer lists only two principles in paraphrase; the passage lists holistic view, equity, access and gender concern and is cut off mid-list, so the annotator should check the next chunk for more.

review.evidence_quote: Therefore, a minimum period of contribution by the subscriber under APY would be 20 years.
review.comment: Correct; trim to the span (the passage says 'would be', not 'is').

review.suggested_question: How many Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV) residential schools have been opened in educational backward blocks?
review.evidence_quote: A total of 750 residential schools have been opened in educational backward blocks.
review.comment: The answer is correct, but the question doesn't name KGBV.

review.suggested_question: How many Soil Health Cards had been distributed to farmers as on 16.05.2017?
review.evidence_quote: As on 16.05.2017, 725 lakh Soil Health Cards have been distributed to the farmers.
review.comment: The passage has no end-of-2016 figure, and the gold answer is about soil samples, not cards (1.12 crore cards by February 2016 is the nearest).

review.suggested_question: What is the maximum NPS investment eligible for tax benefit under Section 80CCD(1)?
review.evidence_quote: Additional investment of up to ₹50,000 under Section 80CCD(1B).
review.comment: The overall maximum is ambiguous because an extra ₹50,000 is allowed under 80CCD(1B); tie the question to 80CCD(1).

review.suggested_question: What is the vision of DDU-GKY?
review.suggested_answer: Transform rural poor youth into an economically independent and globally relevant workforce
review.evidence_quote: The Vision of DDU-GKY is to "Transform rural poor youth into an economically independent and globally relevant workforce".
review.comment: The passage frames this as the 'Vision', not the purpose; use the quoted span.

review.suggested_answer: to meet the comprehensive credit requirements of the agriculture sector
review.evidence_quote: Its objective was to meet the comprehensive credit requirements of the agriculture sector
review.comment: The gold answer is truncated ('ag') and opens with a definition; use the objective span.

review.suggested_answer: to address the issue of the declining child sex ratio (CSR)
review.evidence_quote: It aims to address the issue of the declining child sex ratio image (CSR)
review.comment: The answer restates the question and carries the extraction artifact 'image'; drop it.

review.suggested_question: What funding requirement over five years did the committee project for implementing the Right to Education (RTE) Act?
review.suggested_answer: ₹1710 billion (₹1.71 trillion or approximately US$38.2 billion)
review.evidence_quote: A committee tasked with estimating funding requirements projected a need of ₹1710 billion (₹1.71 trillion or approximately US$38.2 billion) over five years.
review.comment: The gold answer quotes the GDP-share sentence instead of the estimate the passage gives; note the estimate was later revised to ₹2,310 billion.

review.suggested_answer: all government and government-assisted primary schools must provide cooked midday meals
review.evidence_quote: The scheme came into force with the supreme court order dated 28 November 2001, which requires all government and government-assisted primary schools to provide cooked midday meals.
review.comment: The gold answer quotes a generic sentence; the 2001 decision was the order dated 28 November 2001 requiring cooked midday meals.

review.suggested_question: What is the cap on basic allowance for the calculation of EPF?
review.evidence_quote: The cap on the calculation of basic allowance is Rs. 15000.
review.comment: Rs. 15000 caps the basic allowance, not the 'EPF calculation amount'; the question misframes it.

review.suggested_question: Under the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, what must the mother do to receive the third transfer of ₹2,000 (US$21)?
review.suggested_answer: Register the birth; Immunize the child with OPV and BCG at birth, at six weeks and at ten weeks; Attend at least two growth monitoring sessions within three months of delivery
review.evidence_quote:
The third transfer (three and a half months after delivery) of ₹2,000 (US$21) requires the mother to:
Register the birth
review.comment: The answer stops after the first of three conditions, and the question doesn't name the scheme.

review.suggested_question: How many cumulative enrolments did the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) have as of May 2025?
review.evidence_quote: high enrollment figures (over 50 crore cumulative enrollments as of May 2025)
review.comment: The two-part question has no crisp answer, and the gold answer is truncated ('with a 20'); narrow to one fact.

review.suggested_question: What did the Reserve Bank of India permit banks to do that worked against the Jan Dhan scheme's financial-inclusion goal?
review.suggested_answer: charge customers for conducting ATM transactions beyond a certain number of times per month
review.evidence_quote: the Reserve Bank of India, permitted banks to charge customers for conducting ATM transactions beyond a certain number of times per month
review.comment: 'Main issue' is subjective and almost duplicates qa-en-en-000; the answer is also truncated ('ATM (A').

review.suggested_question: What was the claim settlement ratio under PMJJBY and PMSBY as on 28.06.2023?
review.evidence_quote: the claim settlement ratio under PMJJBY and PMSBY as on 28.06.2023 is 99.94% and 97.52% respectively
review.comment: The content is correct; the answer restates the question, and adding the date to the question makes it precise.

review.suggested_question: Which village did Rahul Gandhi adopt under the Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana?
review.evidence_quote: Rahul Gandhi adopted Deeh village in his constituency Amethi in Uttar Pradesh.
review.comment: Name the scheme in the question and trim the answer to the village.

review.suggested_question: What minimum level of disability do the State Disability Pension schemes in Bihar and Rajasthan cover?
review.evidence_quote: states like Bihar and Rajasthan have launched State Disability Pension schemes that cover individuals with more than 40% disability
review.comment: ₹12,000 is not in the passage; it ends at 'The table below shows monthly pension amounts' without the table, and a ₹12,000 monthly pension looks implausible. Rewrite as shown, or relabel as unanswerable if the table isn't in the corpus.

review.suggested_answer: broadband subscribers grew roughly tenfold, from about 99 million in 2014 to 944 million by 2025; UPI transactions grew from ~72 lakh per month in 2016 to ~1790 billion by 2025
review.evidence_quote: broadband subscribers grew roughly tenfold, from about 99 million in 2014 to 944 million by 2025
review.comment: The figures are right, but the answer drops the hedges 'roughly' and 'about'; keep the passage's wording.

review.evidence_quote: give farmers up to ₹6,000 (US$62) per year as minimum income support
review.comment: Correct; trim to the amount span.

review.suggested_question: Which index provides a guide to fixing MGNREGA wages?
review.evidence_quote: The Consumer Price Index-Agriculture Labour (CPI-AL) now provides a guide to fixing MGNREGA wages.
review.comment: The question is garbled: CPI-AL is the guide, not something that has one, and '2019' belongs to a different sentence.

review.suggested_question: By how much is the PDS estimated to have reduced the poverty gap index at the all India level in 2009-10?
review.evidence_quote: it is estimated that in 2009-10, the PDS reduced the poverty gap index by 18-22% at the all India level
review.comment: The question credits the 2009-10 reduction to the NFSA 2013, which came later; the passage credits the PDS.

review.evidence_quote: set aside ₹ 17,000 crore, the highest ever allocation to this sector

review.suggested_question: What share of GDP did the Make in India initiative target for manufacturing by 2022?
review.evidence_quote: its own stated target of increasing the share of manufacturing in GDP to 25% by 2022
review.comment: The question contains its own answer and the gold answer just repeats the question; the scheme is not named.

review.suggested_question: What measures did the government implement to curb leakage and corruption in grain distribution under the PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana?
review.suggested_answer: Aadhaar linkage to ration cards along with fingerprint and OTP-based authentication during distribution
review.evidence_quote: the government implemented Aadhaar linkage to ration cards along with fingerprint and OTP-based authentication during distribution
review.comment: The gold answer is cut off mid-sentence ("all duplicate or"). The question names no scheme; the passage text itself does not name PMGKAY, so the annotator should confirm the scheme name is right.

review.evidence_quote: The average speed of road construction under the PMGSY was 98.5 kilometres per day from 2004 to 2014
review.comment: The answer should be the span, not a sentence restating the question.

review.suggested_question: According to the Union Minister of State for Finance in April 2023, how many entrepreneurs had benefited from the Stand-Up India scheme over the previous seven years?
review.evidence_quote: over the previous seven years, more than 180,000 entrepreneurs had benefited from the scheme
review.comment: The question asks two things, and the 'objective' is actually the National Mission for Financial Inclusion's objective, which the minister said the scheme aligned with. Splitting it into a single-fact question is cleaner.

review.evidence_quote: a target of building 2 crore (20 million) affordable houses by 31 March 2022

review.suggested_question: How many children in the Kabirdham district of Chhattisgarh wrote to their parents to build toilets in their homes?
review.evidence_quote: In the Kabirdham district of Chhattisgarh, around 1.38 lakh children belonging to 1700 schools wrote to their parents to build toilets
review.comment: The passage has two separate facts: the Kabirdham children wrote letters to their parents, while the sketches and essays were by more than 5 crore schoolchildren across the country in 2017. The question mixes them up.

review.suggested_question: What event led to calls in India to boycott Chinese products, in the context of the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan?
review.suggested_answer: the Galwan Valley skirmish on 15 June 2020
review.evidence_quote: There were calls to boycott Chinese products and promote domestic firms following the Galwan Valley skirmish on 15 June 2020
review.comment: The passage talks about calls to boycott Chinese goods, not a government decision to do so, so the question has a false premise. The answer should be the short span.

review.evidence_quote: That detail matters, particularly under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
review.comment: The passage only names the DPDP Act and never defines it. The gold answer is made up ("enacted in 2017" is not in the passage) and cut off. A new item could instead ask when the new Aadhaar app was launched ("28 January 2026").

review.evidence_quote: Modi continued the previous administration's policy of increasing military spending every year, announcing an increase of 11% in the military budget in 2015.
review.comment: The passage gives no reason for the increase, and the gold answer is about the Naga peace agreement, which does not answer the question. The passage is also a Modi-biography defence section filed under 'mudra', so it is off-scheme. If kept, the only answerable version is 'By what percentage was the military budget increased in 2015?' -> '11%'.

review.evidence_quote: bringing the total number of families covered up to 20,000,000

review.suggested_question: By the end of 2010, how many expectant and lactating mothers was the Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) programme claiming to reach?
review.evidence_quote: By end of 2010, the programme is claiming to reach 80.6 lakh expectant and lactating mothers along with 3.93 crore children
review.comment: The passage gives a reach figure, not a 'primary goal', and the question does not name the scheme (ICDS).

review.suggested_question: What are the main programme components of the National Health Mission (NHM)?
review.suggested_answer: Health System Strengthening (RMNCH+A) in rural and urban areas- Reproductive-Maternal- Neonatal-Child and Adolescent Health, and Communicable and Non-Communicable Diseases
review.evidence_quote: The main program components include Health System Strengthening (RMNCH+A) in rural and urban areas- Reproductive-Maternal- Neonatal-Child and Adolescent Health, and Communicable and Non-Communicable Diseases.
review.comment: The passage lists several components; the gold answer gives only the first one and presents it as 'the' main component.

review.suggested_question: What facilities are houses built under the PMGAY scheme equipped with?
review.suggested_answer: toilet, LPG connection, electricity connection, and drinking water
review.evidence_quote: These houses are equipped with facilities such as toilet, LPG connection, electricity connection, and drinking water
review.comment: 'Facilities provided for construction' could be read as the financial assistance (₹120,000/₹130,000). The question should ask what the houses are equipped with, and the answer should be the span.

review.suggested_question: What is the purpose of the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (Prime Minister's Lightening Scheme)?
review.suggested_answer: to distribute 50 million LPG connections to women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families
review.evidence_quote: launched by Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi on 1 May 2016 to distribute 50 million LPG connections to women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families
review.comment: The answer should be the purpose span. Adding the scheme's actual name makes the question more natural for retrieval.

review.suggested_question: How many people does Ayushman Bharat offer services to?
review.evidence_quote: By offering services to 50 crore (500 million) people it is the world's largest government sponsored healthcare program.
review.comment: The gold answer repeats the question and names nothing. This passage chunk never names the program, so 'which program' cannot be answered from it alone.

review.suggested_question: For the account holder's higher education, how much can be withdrawn from a Sukanya Samriddhi account?
review.suggested_answer: 50% of the balance to the account's balance at the close of the previous financial year
review.evidence_quote: the withdrawal of 50% of the balance to the account's balance at the close of the previous financial year is permitted
review.comment: 'The account' does not name the scheme. The gold answer mixes up the 50% balance limit with the fee-based cap. Note that the passage also limits the withdrawal to actual fees and charges, which the annotator may want to include.

review.suggested_answer: to improve comprehensive early reading, writing and early mathematics programme for children in Classes I and II
review.evidence_quote: The programme is designed to improve comprehensive early reading, writing and early mathematics programme for children in Classes I and II.
review.comment: The ₹762 crore figure is not part of the purpose; the answer should be just the purpose span.

review.evidence_quote: Therefore, a minimum period of contribution by the subscriber under APY would be 20 years.
review.comment: The answer should be the span, not a restated sentence.

review.suggested_question: What type of school is the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV)?
review.suggested_answer: a residential girls' secondary school run by the Government of India for the weaker sections in India
review.evidence_quote: The Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya or KGBV is a residential girls' secondary school run by the Government of India for the weaker sections in India.
review.comment: The question is circular: it asks for the name and the answer is the name from the question. It is rewritten to ask for a real fact.

review.suggested_question: आत्मनिर्भर भारत पैकेज के तहत व्यापार और श्रमिकों के लिए ईपीएफ अंशदान कितने महीने के लिए कम किया गया है?
review.evidence_quote: ईपीएफ अंशदान 3 महीने के लिए व्यापार और श्रमिकों के लिए कम हो गया है।
review.comment: The answer is correct, but the question names no scheme or package, so it is not self-contained for retrieval.

review.suggested_question: आधार के लिए कौन नामांकन करवा सकता है?
review.suggested_answer: कोई भी व्यक्ति ... बशर्ते वह भारत का निवासी हो
review.evidence_quote: कोई भी व्यक्ति आधार के लिए नामांकन करवा सकता है बशर्ते वह भारत का निवासी हो
review.comment: 'किन मालिकों' is garbled. The passage also says Aadhaar is not proof of citizenship and that any resident can enroll, so 'भारत के नागरिकों' is misleading as an eligibility answer.

review.suggested_question: पीएम उज्जवला योजना में आवेदन करने वाले कैसे जान सकते हैं कि उन्हें योजना का लाभ मिलेगा या नहीं?
review.suggested_answer: इसकी लिस्ट में अपना नाम चेक कर सकते है
review.evidence_quote: आप जानना चाहते है की आपको इस योजना का लाभ मिलेगा या नहीं तो आप इसकी लिस्ट में अपना नाम चेक कर सकते है
review.comment: This is a yes/no question that copies the passage sentence, and the answer restates it. The annotator may prefer to drop it as low-value.

review.suggested_question: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड किसानों को किन कामों के लिए ऋण उपलब्ध कराता है?
review.suggested_answer: फसल उपज, कृषि उपकरण खरीदने, खेती के लिए उपयुक्त सामग्री खरीदने, और अन्य कृषि संबंधित खर्चों के लिए
review.evidence_quote: जो किसानों को फसल उपज, कृषि उपकरण खरीदने, खेती के लिए उपयुक्त सामग्री खरीदने, और अन्य कृषि संबंधित खर्चों के लिए ऋण उपलब्ध कराता है
review.comment: The question is garbled, and the answer is paraphrased and leaves out 'खेती के लिए उपयुक्त सामग्री खरीदने'.

review.suggested_question: आयुष्मान भारत योजना का प्रत्यक्ष लाभ कितने बीपीएल धारक परिवार उठा सकेंगे?
review.suggested_answer: 10 करोड़ बीपीएल धारक परिवार (लगभग 50 करोड़ लोग)
